channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Trader fined RM5,500 for assaulting elderly man in Cheras road rage incident
item.description: KAJANG: A 52-year-old trader was fined RM5,500 by the magistrate’s court today for assaulting and threatening to kill an elderly man following a minor road accident last Sunday.

item.title: Hartalega Q3 net profit up 62pct despite revenue fall
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Hartalega Holdings Bhd’s net profit rose 62 per cent to RM31.64 million for the third quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, from RM19.51 million a year earlier, despite a 29 per cent drop in revenue to RM527.25 million from RM738.19 million.

item.title: A-GC reviewing proposal to deactivate criminal records after crime-free period, says Saifuddin
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Attorney-General’s Chambers (A-GC) is reviewing proposed amendments to the Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969 (Act 7).

item.title: Strategic significance of India-Malaysia ties
item.description: LETTER: The recent official visit of India's Prime Minister, Narendra Modi, to Malaysia comes at a strategically important moment.

item.title: Out for lunch, back to flames: Man's workshop razed
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: An iron workshop in Kampung Jelutong Barat, Jelutong, was destroyed in a fire today while its owner was away buying food.

item.title: Elderly man crushed to death after cement truck overturns onto pickup
item.description: SIBU: An elderly man was killed after his pickup truck was crushed by a cement truck that overturned in an accident at Jalan Deshon, near SMK Rosli Dhobi, today.

item.title: Two toddlers missing from Kajang apartment found safe on rooftop staircase
item.description: KAJANG: Two toddlers reported missing since last night were found safe this morning on the rooftop staircase of their apartment building in Jalan Reko.

item.title: MISC secures long-term FSO contract in Papua New Guinea
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: MISC Bhd has partnered ExxonMobil PNG Ltd to provide a long-term bareboat charter as well as operations and maintenance services for a floating storage and offloading (FSO) unit in Papua New Guinea.

item.title: Hartono lands at BAM with big dreams for Malaysian shuttlers
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: New national men's singles coach Harry Hartono says he feels no pressure to replicate his past success with Indonesian stars like Anthony Ginting and Jonatan Christie.
